caption: The drawing features a single three-dimensional object positioned towards the center of a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a large spiral coil with a dark brown, metallic appearance. Attached to the left side of the coil are three circular loops of varying sizes and a prominent, smooth, round sphere. The right side of the coil extends into a conical shape, from which six straight rods radiate outward equally spaced around the axis, resembling spokes. The entire object is rendered in shades of brown with highlights indicating a metallic texture. Near the bottom right corner of the image is the text “HARRY M WANDELL” in small, uppercase letters.
title: Spur
